rationale: The 24-pair pilot shows original/replacement duration autocorrelations 0.405/0.281 at lag 1 and 0.286/0.283 at lag 2. Two-pair-block lag-1 duration correlations remain 0.341/0.215; four-pair blocks reduce these to 0.097/0.081. Choose four pairs, retaining two AB/BA cycles and 10 confirmatory blocks; eight pairs leave only 3 pilot and 5 confirmatory blocks. Half-run duration shifts are shared (-1.378%/-1.379%); mean log-ratio drift is 3.67e-7 and the AB-minus-BA log-ratio difference is -2.36e-6. Four-pair-block log-ratio correlations (-0.329, -0.344, 0.392 at lags 1-3) remain noisy with only 6 pilot blocks. This is a compromise, not proof of independence: inference assumes independent representative blocks and gives no guarantee under arbitrary dependence or drift. The review used only serial, drift and order diagnostics, without absolute times, average speed levels, confidence intervals or significance.
